findings.quote: at the same period as the so-called Phlegraean plains around Capua and Nola—plains which
findings.problem: Greek: καθ᾽ οὓς χρόνους καὶ τὰ Φλέγραιά ποτε καλούμενα τὰ περὶ Καπύην καὶ Νώλην — the Phlegraean plains are a second object of ἐνέμοντο (the Etruscans held them too, at the time), not a term of temporal comparison.
findings.proposed_fix: at the time when they also held the once so-called Phlegraean plains around Capua and Nola—plains which

findings.quote: those lying toward the eastern part of the Po
findings.problem: Greek: περὶ τὰς ἀνατολὰς τοῦ Πάδου — ἀνατολαί of the river means its rising/sources (the Laoi and Lebecii are the westernmost, near the Po's source), not its 'eastern part'; the Greek word is open to 'risings' but 'eastern part' reverses the geography.
findings.proposed_fix: those lying around the sources of the Po

units.note: Both findings rest on ἀνατολαί/καθ᾽ οὓς χρόνους καί readings; the second is mildly ambiguous in the Greek.
